executions.stdout:
Trace any resource back to its controller/source evidence.

You don't need to know which tool manages a resource. Just run trace and
cub-scout auto-detects the owner and shows the full delivery chain.

Under the hood:
  - Flux resources: uses 'flux trace'
  - ArgoCD resources: reads Application CRs from the selected Kubernetes cluster
  - Helm resources: reads release metadata
  - Sveltos resources: reads Profile/ClusterProfile owner and reference annotations
  - Modelplane resources: reads Modelplane API objects, labels, ownerRefs, and status

The value: In mixed environments with multiple GitOps tools, one command
traces any resource without switching between controller-specific CLIs.

Examples:
  # Trace a deployment
  cub-scout trace deployment/nginx -n demo

  # Trace with kind and name separately
  cub-scout trace Deployment nginx -n demo

  # Trace an Argo CD application directly
  cub-scout trace --app frontend-app

  # Reverse trace - start from any resource (e.g., a Pod) and walk up
  cub-scout trace pod/nginx-7d9b8c-x4k2p -n prod --reverse

  # Compare one already-rendered object with the selected live object
  cub-scout trace deployment/nginx -n demo --diff --desired-file ./rendered --api-version apps/v1

  # Output as JSON
  cub-scout trace deployment/nginx -n demo --json

  # Show deployment history (who deployed what, when)
  cub-scout trace deployment/nginx -n demo --history

The output shows:
  - The full chain from source/controller metadata â†’ deployer/controller â†’ resource
  - Status and revision at each level
  - Where in the chain something is broken (if applicable)

Reverse trace (--reverse) walks ownerReferences to find:
  - The K8s ownership chain (Pod â†’ ReplicaSet â†’ Deployment)
  - The controller owner (Flux, ArgoCD, Sveltos, Modelplane, Helm, or Native)

Diff mode (--diff) compares one caller-rendered object with one live object:
  - Requires --desired-file; cub-scout does not render Git or predict reconciliation
  - Reports the selected context and exact live-read evidence
  - Controller-desired diffs are not yet supported

Render manifests with your existing tool (for example, helm template or
kustomize build), then pass that output with --desired-file. The former
automatic controller CLI diff delegation is disabled.

Trace context troubleshooting (ArgoCD):
  - Select the Kubernetes context with --kube-context
  - Specify the Application namespace with -n
  - Kubernetes Application read permission is required; Argo server login is not used
  - Rendered diff reads the selected Kubernetes API directly; controller-rendered desired state is not yet supported

Usage:
  cub-scout trace <kind/name> or <kind> <name> [flags]

Flags:
      --api-version string             Exact desired API version when same-name documents are ambiguous (requires --diff --desired-file)
      --app string                     Trace Argo CD application by name
      --artifacts                      Include source artifact provenance (url/revision/digest/update time)
      --confighub-since string         Lookback window for ConfigHub release/event evidence (examples: 24h, 7d, 2w) (default "24h")
      --confighub-space string         ConfigHub space for delivery evidence (default: resource ConfigHub space; use '*' explicitly for all spaces)
      --confighub-stale-after string   Treat ConfigHub live-status observations older than this as stale (default "15m")
      --desired-file string            Already-rendered local manifest file/directory to compare (requires --diff)
  -d, --diff                           Compare one already-rendered object with the selected live object
      --explain                        Show explanatory content to help learn GitOps concepts
      --format string                  Output format: ascii, json, md (default "ascii")
  -h, --help                           help for trace
      --history                        Show deployment history (who deployed what, when)
      --kube-context string            Use this exact Kubernetes context for trace reads
      --limit int                      Limit number of history entries (default: 10) (default 10)
  -n, --namespace string               Namespace of the resource (default: flux-system; Application names must be unique if omitted)
      --presentation string            Presentation mode: human, ai (concise for AI assistants), paired (human+AI workflow); omit the flag to keep the legacy/default render path
  -r, --reverse                        Reverse trace - walk ownerReferences up to find GitOps source
      --with-confighub                 Include bounded ConfigHub delivery evidence when the resource exposes exact ConfigHub correlation

executions.stdout:
Trace any resource back to its controller/source evidence.

You don't need to know which tool manages a resource. Just run trace and
cub-scout auto-detects the owner and shows the full delivery chain.

Under the hood:
  - Flux resources: uses 'flux trace'
  - ArgoCD resources: reads Application CRs from the selected Kubernetes cluster
  - Helm resources: reads release metadata
  - Sveltos resources: reads Profile/ClusterProfile owner and reference annotations
  - Modelplane resources: reads Modelplane API objects, labels, ownerRefs, and status

The value: In mixed environments with multiple GitOps tools, one command
traces any resource without switching between controller-specific CLIs.

Examples:
  # Trace a deployment
  cub-scout trace deployment/nginx -n demo

  # Trace with kind and name separately
  cub-scout trace Deployment nginx -n demo

  # Trace an Argo CD application directly
  cub-scout trace --app frontend-app

  # Reverse trace - start from any resource (e.g., a Pod) and walk up
  cub-scout trace pod/nginx-7d9b8c-x4k2p -n prod --reverse

  # Compare one already-rendered object with the selected live object
  cub-scout trace deployment/nginx -n demo --diff --desired-file ./rendered --api-version apps/v1

  # Output as JSON
  cub-scout trace deployment/nginx -n demo --json

  # Show deployment history (who deployed what, when)
  cub-scout trace deployment/nginx -n demo --history

The output shows:
  - The full chain from source/controller metadata â†’ deployer/controller â†’ resource
  - Status and revision at each level
  - Where in the chain something is broken (if applicable)

Reverse trace (--reverse) walks ownerReferences to find:
  - The K8s ownership chain (Pod â†’ ReplicaSet â†’ Deployment)
  - The controller owner (Flux, ArgoCD, Sveltos, Modelplane, Helm, or Native)

Diff mode (--diff) compares one caller-rendered object with one live object:
  - Requires --desired-file; cub-scout does not render Git or predict reconciliation
  - Reports the selected context and exact live-read evidence
  - Controller-desired diffs are not yet supported

Render manifests with your existing tool (for example, helm template or
kustomize build), then pass that output with --desired-file. The former
automatic controller CLI diff delegation is disabled.

Trace context troubleshooting (ArgoCD):
  - Select the Kubernetes context with --kube-context
  - Specify the Application namespace with -n
  - Kubernetes Application read permission is required; Argo server login is not used
  - Rendered diff reads the selected Kubernetes API directly; controller-rendered desired state is not yet supported

Usage:
  cub-scout trace <kind/name> or <kind> <name> [flags]

Flags:
      --api-version string             Exact desired API version when same-name documents are ambiguous (requires --diff --desired-file)
      --app string                     Trace Argo CD application by name
      --artifacts                      Include source artifact provenance (url/revision/digest/update time)
      --confighub-since string         Lookback window for ConfigHub release/event evidence (examples: 24h, 7d, 2w) (default "24h")
      --confighub-space string         ConfigHub space for delivery evidence (default: resource ConfigHub space; use '*' explicitly for all spaces)
      --confighub-stale-after string   Treat ConfigHub live-status observations older than this as stale (default "15m")
      --desired-file string            Already-rendered local manifest file/directory to compare (requires --diff)
  -d, --diff                           Compare one already-rendered object with the selected live object
      --explain                        Show explanatory content to help learn GitOps concepts
      --format string                  Output format: ascii, json, md (default "ascii")
  -h, --help                           help for trace
      --history                        Show deployment history (who deployed what, when)
      --kube-context string            Use this exact Kubernetes context for trace reads
      --limit int                      Limit number of history entries (default: 10) (default 10)
  -n, --namespace string               Namespace of the resource (default: flux-system; Application names must be unique if omitted)
      --presentation string            Presentation mode: human, ai (concise for AI assistants), paired (human+AI workflow); omit the flag to keep the legacy/default render path
  -r, --reverse                        Reverse trace - walk ownerReferences up to find GitOps source
      --with-confighub                 Include bounded ConfigHub delivery evidence when the resource exposes exact ConfigHub correlation
